name: Ancient Dragon Priestess
desc:
1 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
(This card is always treated as an "Invoked" and "Magistus" card.)
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can activate this effect; until the end of this turn, all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls lose 1800 ATK, also negate their effects. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Magistus" or "Aleister" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Ancient Dragon Priestess" once per turn.
